The published nonzero balanced term of 2^{n-1} distinct variables disproves (2^{n-1}-1)-supernilpotency. Hence least parameters n and 2^{n-1}. Independent bottom-up capacity recursion checked n=3..9 as finite confirmation; general proof uses the elementary binary-tree leaves/depth inequality.
